video.decoding_capability: Realtime and archive: main stream 1 channel; sub stream up to 16 channels (720p)

features: Maximum video capacity: H.264: 16 x 8MP@15fps IP cameras or 1 x 12MP@15fps + 15 x 8MP@15fps; H.265: 16 x 8MP@15fps IP cameras
Bitrate per channel: main stream up to 8 Mbps, sub stream up to 1 Mbps
PoE ports are 10/100/1000 Mbps, up to 13 W each
D-SUB and HDMI outputs duplicate or independent; independent monitors limited to 1920x1080
Supports ActiveCam, TRASSIR, Hikvision, HiWatch, Dahua, Wisenet-Samsung IP cameras and ONVIF and RTSP cameras
Remote access via TRASSIR Client, web browser, Android/iOS app and cloud
notes: HDD bay count left out: the datasheet and product page overview give 2 HDDs, the product page specification table gives 8.
Power consumption left out: the datasheet gives up to 220 W, the product page gives 280 W.
Weight is the datasheet net weight; gross weight is 3.8 kg.
